root_cause: The Windows Conditional Compilation build job's 'Cmake build - CC ON' step failed (the job as a whole concluded 'failure') shortly after a successful CMake configure, but GitHub Actions never persisted retrievable log content for this job - both the pre-downloaded log file and a live get_job_logs call return only '(log download failed)' / HTTP 404. This is the fifth recorded occurrence of pattern afb479532c52bf68 (Windows CC build job logs unavailable via the Actions API). Like several prior occurrences, the step-level metadata is also inconsistent/incomplete: 'Cmake build - CC ON' is reported as still 'in_progress' with no completed_at or conclusion, even though the overall job concluded 'failure' about 4 minutes after the step started - indicating the GitHub Actions log/telemetry pipeline for this Windows AKS build runner pool is dropping both the log content and the final step status for this job, not merely one or the other. The merged commit (PR #39391, adding GGUF mmproj metadata export for separator weights and FFN name normalization for legacy MiniCPM resampler projectors) touches only the GGUF frontend and its tests (3 changed files, +253/-10), which is a narrow, additive change unlikely to crash the Windows build toolchain itself without producing any compiler/linker diagnostic in the one log that did survive (the aggregator status job). Because no compiler or linker error text is available at all, a code-level defect introduced by PR #39391 cannot be fully ruled out, but the complete absence of error text combined with the well-established recurring 404-log/missing-step-status signature on this exact job/workflow strongly favors an infrastructure/log-pipeline issue on the AKS Windows build runner pool rather than a regression from this PR.
reproduction_steps: N/A - cannot be reproduced locally; the failure signature is an infrastructure/log-retrieval issue on GitHub's Windows self-hosted (AKS) runner pool, not a deterministic local build failure. To attempt reproduction: re-run the 'Windows Conditional Compilation (VS 2022, Python 3.11)' workflow against commit b2bdae44a7c5372a7dae59e90bee72661e95153d and check whether 'Cmake build - CC ON' again fails/hangs while runner telemetry/logs remain unavailable.
recommended_actions: Re-run the 'Conditional Compilation' job for this commit; if it passes on a clean retry, this further confirms the infrastructure/log-retention theory rather than a code defect in PR #39391's GGUF frontend changes.

If the job still fails on retry, inspect the raw workflow run logs ZIP (via get_workflow_run_logs_url) instead of the per-job log API, since the per-job download endpoint has now failed 404 on at least 5 separate post-commit runs for this specific job/workflow.

Escalate to GitHub Actions / self-hosted runner infrastructure owners: the 'aks-win-16-cores-32gb-build' runner pool for Windows CC builds has repeatedly failed to persist both job logs (HTTP 404) and accurate step completion status (step stuck 'in_progress' despite job conclusion 'failure') across at least 5 incidents since 2026-10-10, suggesting a systemic logging/telemetry gap on this runner image or pool rather than isolated flakiness.

As a defensive measure, consider adding step-level log archiving (e.g., tee build output to an uploaded artifact) in windows_conditional_compilation.yml so build output survives even if the GitHub Actions log API fails to persist/return it.
prevention_strategies: Add redundant log capture (artifact upload of raw ninja/MSBuild output) for the Windows CC build step so investigations are not blocked when the GitHub Actions log API returns 404. Track the afb479532c52bf68 pattern's recurrence rate; it has now reached 5 occurrences since 2026-10-10 and should be escalated as a dedicated infrastructure ticket against the AKS Windows build runner pool rather than relying on ad-hoc re-investigation each time. AI agent note: When a Windows Conditional Compilation ('Cmake build - CC ON') job fails and job log download returns HTTP 404 (both pre-downloaded log and live get_job_logs), with step metadata showing an inconsistent/incomplete state (e.g. step stuck 'in_progress' despite the job itself concluding 'failure'), do not block the investigation trying to force log retrieval. Immediately check the post-commit pattern database for signature afb479532c52bf68 - if found, treat this as a very likely recurrence of a known Windows AKS runner infrastructure/log-retention issue rather than a code defect in the triggering PR. Only deep-dive into the PR diff when no 404/log-unavailability pattern match exists.
historical_context: This is the 5th recorded occurrence of signature afb479532c52bf68 ('Windows build job terminated mid-build with unavailable job logs'), first seen 2026-10-10 (run 38092857471, PR #38105) and most recently seen 2026-11-22T13:37:00Z (run 45023224702, PR #38097) before this one. All five occurrences involve the exact same job name 'Conditional Compilation' / step 'Cmake build - CC ON' on the aks-win-16-cores-32gb-build runner pool, each with the GitHub Actions log API returning HTTP 404 and no retrievable compiler/linker error text. A related but distinct pattern (73496f939a352d74, count=1) recorded a similar Windows CC job being outright cancelled mid-compilation; and a much more frequent pattern (80cfa127185fbf3e, count=18) covers Windows CC builds that DO produce retrievable logs showing explicit LNK1102/C1060 out-of-memory errors under high build parallelism - this run could not be confirmed as that OOM pattern because no log content was available to verify.
